edges.reason: _transfer records the last transfer block for the caller-controlled origin
tx.origin is used as the key for the anti-bot transfer delay mapping, allowing origin spoofing via relays
block.timestamp is stored as first buy time and later compared with a 24 hour window to alter taxes
_transfer writes holder first buy timestamps used by the early sell tax branch
_transfer dynamically reassigns sellTotalFees from early sell fee variables
_transfer applies buyTotalFees to compute fee amounts on purchases
early sell fee group overwrites live sellTotalFees during transfers
_transfer triggers swapBack, which performs external ETH transfers before balances/fees are fully settled
_transfer sets and clears the swapping reentrancy guard around swapBack
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet using a low-level call before finishing accounting
swapBack sends the entire remaining balance to marketingWallet via low-level call
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert accumulated tokens
swapBack calls addLiquidity with the retained liquidity token portion
swapTokensForEth makes an external Uniswap router call that can re-enter the token contract
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline to the router
swapBack recomputes and zeroes the marketing/liquidity/dev fee token buckets
ERC20 transfer routes _msgSender() as the from address of _transfer
Chire performs transferFrom(msg.sender, ...) after self-approving owner, creating a privileged transfer path
Chire calls _approve(owner(), owner(), totalSupply()) granting unlimited self allowance
enableTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner
updateSwapTokensAtAmount is gated by onlyOwner
updateBuyFees is gated by onlyOwner
updateSellFees is gated by onlyOwner
updateMarketingWallet is gated by onlyOwner
updateDevWallet is gated by onlyOwner
blacklistAccount is gated by onlyOwner, letting the owner freeze arbitrary users
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner
transferOwnership reassigns the _owner state variable
updateMarketingWallet reassigns the marketing fee recipient
updateDevWallet reassigns the dev fee recipient
enableTrading sets tradingActive permanently true
enableTrading sets swapEnabled true, activating fee swaps
enableTrading sets launchedAt from block.number, opening the anti-bot window
_transfer auto-blacklists recipients during the launch block window
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells
_transfer enforces maxWallet on buys and wallet transfers
blacklistAccount writes arbitrary addresses into the _blacklist mapping
_transfer reads enableEarlySellTax to select the punitive fee branch
excludeFromFees updates the fee exemption mapping for arbitrary accounts
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair updates the AMM pair mapping that steers buy/sell fee logic

normalization_plan.reason: Address parameter is only meaningful as the source argument of the _transfer dataflow
Address parameter is only meaningful as the destination argument of the _transfer dataflow
Amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer fee and limit computations
Local balance snapshot controls the swapBack trigger inside _transfer
Local fee accumulator is computed and applied entirely within _transfer
Token amount parameter is consumed only by the swapTokensForEth router call
Swap path array is constructed only for the swapTokensForEth router call
Recipient array parameter is only used to drive the airdrop loop in Chire
Value array parameter is only used to scale the transferFrom amounts in Chire
New owner parameter is only meaningful as the assignment target of _owner in transferOwnership
New wallet parameter is only meaningful as the assignment target of marketingWallet
Numeric parameter is only meaningful as the bounded update of the swap threshold
